d7097fa47801ff6726d6b6f8fd5a334266e19692.sourceText: 这很像内存管理里的`new`和`delete`所面临的问题，在内存管理中，我们使用的是RAII思路去解决这个问题，也就是智能指针。
d7097fa47801ff6726d6b6f8fd5a334266e19692.translatedText: This is very similar to the problem faced in memory management by`new`and`delete`, and in memory management, we use the RAII approach to solve this problem, that is, smart pointers\.

d710b835e16e2e5344d01b18dfad5382da412a31.sourceText:
| 场景 | 推荐写法 | 原因 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 局部变量类型很明显 | `auto x = expr;` | 少写重复类型 |
| 只读遍历大对象 | `const auto& x` | 避免拷贝，同时不允许修改 |
| 要修改原对象 | `auto& x` | 明确拿到引用 |
| 可能为空的指针 | `auto* p = get();` | 让读者一眼看出这是指针 |
| 函数返回引用且必须保留引用 | `decltype(auto)` | `auto` 返回值会丢失引用 |
| 类型本身是业务含义 | 显式类型 | 例如 `Meter distance = ...` 比 `auto distance` 更清楚 |
d710b835e16e2e5344d01b18dfad5382da412a31.translatedText:
| Scenario | Recommended写法 | Reason |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Local variable type is obvious | `auto x = expr;` | Avoid repeating the type |
| Read\-only traversal of large objects | `const auto& x` | Avoid copying while disallowing modification |
| Need to modify the original object | `auto& x` | Explicitly obtain a reference |
| Pointer that may be null | `auto* p = get();` | Let readers see at a glance that this is a pointer |
| Function returns a reference and the reference must be preserved | `decltype(auto)` | `auto` The return value will lose the reference |
| The type itself carries business meaning | Explicit type | For example `Meter distance = ...` than `auto distance` is clearer |

d714fa31900aec8f15cb8c190575980c59b6c0ed.sourceText: 如果构造函数抛出异常，对象创建失败，程序会跳转到 `catch` 中处理异常。
d714fa31900aec8f15cb8c190575980c59b6c0ed.translatedText: If the constructor throws an exception, object creation fails, and the program jumps to `catch` to handle the exception\.

d7294ef7ad1fdb366a7156a717a0378b5dede339.sourceText: 加载先验地图不会自动完成全局重定位，也不会自动确定机器人在整张地图中的位置。初始位置、姿态和地图坐标必须足够一致，后续局部匹配才有基础。
d7294ef7ad1fdb366a7156a717a0378b5dede339.translatedText: Loading a prior map does not automatically accomplish global relocalization, nor does it automatically determine the robot's position within the entire map\. The initial position, pose, and map coordinates must be sufficiently consistent so that subsequent local matching has a basis\.

d73add8e6287cb0422120fc116bbb1dd582b4ea7.sourceText: 因此 `decayTime=0.5` 是更新时检查的年龄阈值，不是点到0.5秒就立刻消失。稀疏缓存格可能等到时间更新门槛才重新检查；没有新点云时，这段处理不会执行。增大衰减时间有利于保留地面样本，也可能延长旧物体残留；减小则需观察稀疏格是否出现空洞。
d73add8e6287cb0422120fc116bbb1dd582b4ea7.translatedText: Therefore, `decayTime=0.5` is the age threshold checked during updates, not something that disappears immediately when it reaches 0\.5 seconds\. A sparse cache cell may wait until the time update threshold before being rechecked; when there is no new point cloud, this processing will not execute\. Increasing the decay time helps retain ground samples, but may also prolong the residual presence of old objects; if decreased, it is necessary to observe whether holes appear in sparse cells\.
